description: This PHP file defines a REST API class 'NationalityAPI' for managing nationality entities in an HRM system. It provides endpoints for CRUD operations, including get, list, create, update, and delete nationalities, with validation rules and Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: NationalityAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for managing Nationality entities, providing full CRUD operations with validation and documentation annotations.

methods.name: getNationalityService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the NationalityService used for business logic related to nationalities.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single Nationality record by ID, returning a resource result or throwing if not found.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all Nationalities with optional sorting and pagination, returning a collection result.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Nationality record from request data.

methods.name: saveNationality
methods.description: Helper method that sets the name on a Nationality entity and saves it via the service.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Nationality record by ID with provided data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes multiple Nationality records by IDs provided in the request.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the getOne method, ensuring ID is positive.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Defines validation rules for listing nationalities, including sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for creating a nationality, primarily the 'name' field.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for updating a nationality, including ignoring the current record in uniqueness check.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Creates validation rule for the 'name' parameter, enforcing string type, max length, and uniqueness.
